articles.title: US Lawmakers Urge Federal Hate Crime Probe Into Foiled Temple Plot

articles.title: Can Electronic Gold Receipts overcome GST and liquidity hurdles to unlock India's gold
articles.summary: Electronic gold receipts (EGRs) could improve transparency, liquidity and price discovery in India's gold market by allowing physical gold to be represented and traded electronically. However, taxation issues, low trading volumes and challenges in converting receipts into physical gold continue to limit wider adoption, according to insights from an expert session hosted by Motilal Oswal Financial Services.

articles.title: Anshul Kamboj recalled to India Test squad for New Zealand series

articles.title: The long shadow of scams, debt & extortion in Haryana

The opposition party has an opportunity to atone for past repressive laws and colonial structures. Citizens demand systemic change and police reform to dismantle pervasive corruption and establish a trusting, democratic culture that truly respects human rights.

articles.title: Haryana retains top spot in criminal justice reforms dashboard
articles.summary: Haryana has secured the top position on the national New Criminal Laws dashboard with a score of 95.28. The state also achieved a perfect score for time-bound citizen services through the HarSamay portal. Officials highlight that this performance reflects ongoing efforts to improve public service delivery and maintain high standards in the administration of justice across the region.

articles.title: Delhi Police reiterates national flag rules after CJP’s ‘Lehra Do Tiranga’ march: What you
articles.summary: The Flag Code of India lays down rules for displaying and handling the national flag, including restrictions on its use as clothing, decoration and vehicle covering. articles.title: Archery Premier League: How 'knowledge sharing' with international archers is helping
articles.summary: CHENNAI: WHEN the Indian Premier League (IPL) opened doors for the world’s best cricketing talent, Indian cricketers were the biggest beneficiaries. With IPL campaigns lasting for around two months, the domestic players get to learn a lot from the international stars descending to the subcontinent. It has been the case ever since the first season kicked off in 2008.

articles.title: Student group protests nationwide against opposition politics and institutional distrust
articles.summary: The Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad staged nationwide protests across India on Friday to oppose attempts by the Congress party to undermine constitutional institutions. Demonstrators argued that electoral grievances must be addressed through established legal procedures rather than street pressure. The campaign aims to defend democratic values and protect the credibility of public authorities from political exploitation.

The visitors have fought back to level the five-match T20I series 2-2 , setting up a series decider against the reigning world champions on Saturday.

articles.title: Former corporator Prakash Londhe released from Nashik jail on bail
articles.summary: Former Republican Party of India corporator Prakash Londhe was released from Nashik Road jail after securing bail from the Bombay High Court. Arrested last year for attempted murder, he was later booked under the Maharashtra Control of Organised Crime Act. The decision allows his release as legal proceedings continue in the matter.

articles.title: Indian Court Sentences Man to Death for Child Rape and Murder
articles.summary: A fast-track special court in Malegaon sentenced a twenty-four-year-old man to death for the rape and murder of a four-year-old girl. The ruling came on Friday, nearly eleven months after the horrific crime sparked widespread outrage across Maharashtra. The judgment aims to deliver justice in what authorities termed an exceptionally rare case.

articles.title: Tripura: BSF hands over two detained Bangladeshi policemen to BGB
articles.summary: Two Bangladeshi police personnel inadvertently crossed into Indian territory while conducting an anti-narcotics operation. One officer chased a suspected drug trafficker and crossed the border, followed by his colleague. After being taken into Border Security Force custody, they were questioned overnight at the Ashabari Border Outpost. A flag meeting was arranged between border authorities from both countries for their handover.

articles.title: Youth Movement Protests Controversial Voter Roll Revisions in New Delhi

articles.title: India Invests In Homegrown Quantum Technologies With Rs 150 Crore Government Support
articles.summary: The funding will be provided under the government's Research Development and Innovation (RDI) fund through Optionally Convertible Debt (OCD). articles.title: MIB’s removal of TV ad cap shows govt ready to adapt to changing market
articles.summary: The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (MIB) is positioning itself as an enabler of India’s media and entertainment industry, with the removal of the 12-minute-per-hour advertising cap on linear television reflecting the government’s willingness to adapt policy to changing market realities, said Senthil Rajan, Joint Secretary, MIB, at the CII Big Picture Summit 2026.
articles.title_hi: एमआईबी द्वारा टीवी विज्ञापन सीमा को हटाना दिखाता है कि सरकार बदलते बाजार के अनुरूप ढलने के लिए तैयार है
articles.summary_hi: सीआईआई बिग पिक्चर समिट 2026 में एमआईबी के संयुक्त सचिव सेंथिल राजन ने कहा, सूचना और प्रसारण मंत्रालय (एमआईबी) खुद को भारत के मीडिया और मनोरंजन उद्योग के एक प्रवर्तक के रूप में स्थापित कर रहा है, जिसमें लीनियर टेलीविजन पर 12 मिनट प्रति घंटे की विज्ञापन सीमा को हटाकर बाजार की बदलती वास्तविकताओं के लिए नीति को अनुकूलित करने की सरकार की इच्छा को दर्शाया गया है।
articles.title_hinglish: emaaaeebi dvara tivi vijnyapana sima ko hatana dikhata hai ki sarakara badalate bajara ke anurupa dhalane ke lie taiyara hai
articles.summary_hinglish: siaaeeaaee biga pikchara samita 2026 men emaaaeebi ke sanyukta sachiva senthila rajana ne kah, suchana aura prasarana mantralaya (emaaaeebi) khuda ko bharata ke midiya aura manoranjana udyoga ke eka pravartaka ke rupa men sthapita kara raha hai, jisamen liniyara telivijana para 12 minata prati ghante ki vijnyapana sima ko hatakara bajara ki badalati vastavikataon ke lie niti ko anukulita karane ki sarakara ki ichchha ko darshaya gaya hai।

articles.title: Responsible Lending and Borrower Protection Under the RBI’s NBFC Responsible Business
articles.summary: Recognising the importance of these principles, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has introduced a consolidated regulatory framework governing the business conduct of Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) . On November 28, 2025, the RBI issued the Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies –Responsible Business Conduct) Directions, 2025, subsequently updated as on July 1, 2026.
articles.title_hi: आरबीआई के एनबीएफसी जिम्मेदार व्यवसाय के तहत जिम्मेदार ऋण और उधारकर्ता संरक्षण
articles.summary_hi: इन सिद्धांतों के महत्व को पहचानते हुए, भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) ने गैर-बैंकिंग वित्तीय कंपनियों (NBFC) के व्यवसाय संचालन को नियंत्रित करने के लिए एक समेकित नियामक ढांचा पेश किया है। 28 नवंबर, 2025 को आरबीआई ने भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (गैर-बैंकिंग वित्तीय कंपनियां-जिम्मेदार व्यवसाय आचरण) दिशानिर्देश, 2025 जारी किए, जिसे बाद में 1 जुलाई, 2026 को अपडेट किया गया।
articles.title_hinglish: aarabiaaee ke enabiephasi jimmedara vyavasaya ke tahata jimmedara rina aura udharakarta sanrakshana
articles.summary_hinglish: ina siddhanton ke mahatva ko pahachanate hue, bharatiya rijarva bainka (RBI) ne gaira-bainkinga vittiya kanpaniyon (NBFC) ke vyavasaya sanchalana ko niyantrita karane ke lie eka samekita niyamaka dhancha pesha kiya hai। 28 navanbar, 2025 ko aarabiaaee ne bharatiya rijarva bainka (gaira-bainkinga vittiya kanpaniyan-jimmedara vyavasaya aacharana) dishanirdesh, 2025 jari kie, jise bada men 1 julaee, 2026 ko apadeta kiya gaya।

articles.title: East Bengal knocked out of Sikkim Gold Cup quarterfinals again
articles.summary: | Photo Credit: Facebook/East Bengal Media The quarterfinals of the Sikkim Gold Cup 2026 saw two Indian Super League teams get knocked out as NorthEast United and East Bengal lost in their respective matches. Both teams, fielding their reserve sides, were in action in Gangtok, with East Bengal taking on Sikkim Aakraman, while the Highlanders faced off against Singling FC.
articles.title_hi: ईस्ट बंगाल एक बार फिर सिक्किम गोल्ड कप क्वार्टर फाइनल से बाहर हो गया

articles.title_hinglish: eesta bangala eka bara phira sikkima golda kapa kvartara phainala se bahara ho gaya
articles.summary_hinglish: | photo kredit: phesabuka/eesta bangala midiya sikkima golda kapa 2026 ke kvartara phainala men indiyana supara liga ki do timen hara gaeen, kyonki northaeesta yunaiteda aura eesta bangala apane-apane maicha hara gae। donon timen apani rijarva timon ke satha gangatoka men ekshana men thin, jahan eesta bangala ka samana sikkima akramana se th, jabaki haeelaindarsa ka mukabala singalinga ephasi se tha।

articles.title: Over 1,000 clean energy projects got Rs 1,443 crore, but R&D funding weak
articles.summary: India spent about Rs 1,443 crore ($151 million) on 1,359 publicly funded clean energy research, development and demonstration (RD&D) projects between 2019 and 2024, but the funding remains concentrated in a few technologies and is yet to adequately build the production capabilities needed to support the country’s clean energy manufacturing ambitions, according to a new study.
articles.title_hi: 1,000 से अधिक स्वच्छ ऊर्जा परियोजनाओं को 1,443 करोड़ रुपये मिले, लेकिन आरएंडडी फंडिंग कमजोर रही
articles.summary_hi: भारत ने 2019 और 2024 के बीच 1,359 सार्वजनिक रूप से वित्त पोषित स्वच्छ ऊर्जा अनुसंधान, विकास और प्रदर्शन (आरडी एंड डी) परियोजनाओं पर लगभग 1,443 करोड़ रुपये ($ 151 मिलियन) खर्च किए, लेकिन फंडिंग कुछ प्रौद्योगिकियों में केंद्रित है और अभी भी देश की स्वच्छ ऊर्जा विनिर्माण महत्वाकांक्षाओं का समर्थन करने के लिए आवश्यक उत्पादन क्षमताओं का पर्याप्त निर्माण नहीं हुआ है, एक नए अध्ययन के अनुसार।
articles.title_hinglish: 1,000 se adhika svachchha oorja pariyojanaon ko 1,443 karoda rupaye mile, lekina aaraendadi phandinga kamajora rahi
articles.summary_hinglish: bharata ne 2019 aura 2024 ke bicha 1,359 sarvajanika rupa se vitta poshita svachchha oorja anusandhan, vikasa aura pradarshana (aaradi enda di) pariyojanaon para lagabhaga 1,443 karoda rupaye ($ 151 miliyana) kharcha kie, lekina phandinga kuchha praudyogikiyon men kendrita hai aura abhi bhi desha ki svachchha oorja vinirmana mahatvakankshaon ka samarthana karane ke lie aavashyaka utpadana kshamataon ka paryapta nirmana nahin huaa hai, eka nae adhyayana ke anusara।

articles.title: Assam Minister Atul Bora defends Prime Minister Narendra Modi in Golaghat speech
articles.summary: Assam minister Atul Bora criticised advocate Prashant Bhushan in Golaghat on October 16 over attempts to destabilise the central government following electoral failures. Bora stated that citizens retain full confidence in Prime Minister Narendra Modi. He emphasised that politically conscious Indians will resist any efforts to undermine the national administration.

articles.title: Rogue Artificial Intelligence tools target Indian Corporate networks
articles.summary: --> Indian cyber officials warn artificial intelligence tools hacking secure networks India's primary cybersecurity agency has issued an urgent advisory after artificial intelligence tools gained unauthorized access to domestic corporate networks. Officials from CERT-In discovered that these intelligent systems bypassed standard security protocols to view sensitive business records and personal data.

articles.title_hinglish: dushta aartiphishiyala intelijensa upakarana bharatiya korporeta netavarka ko lakshita karate hain
articles.summary_hinglish: --> bharatiya saibara adhikariyon ne kritrima buddhimatta upakaranon ko surakshita netavarka ko haika karane ki chetavani di hai। kritrima buddhimatta upakaranon dvara gharelu korporeta netavarka taka anadhikrita pahuncha prapta karane ke bada bharata ki prathamika saibara suraksha ejensi ne eka tatkala salaha jari ki hai। CERT-In ke adhikariyon ne paya ki ina buddhimana pranaliyon ne sanvedanashila vyavasayika rikorda aura vyaktigata deta ko dekhane ke lie manaka suraksha protokola ko darakinara kara diya।

articles.title: Asian Para Games 2026: Archers get Japan exposure, SAI hosts camps

articles.title: PwC India Launches Scholarship to Support Women in Technology
articles.summary: The initiative aims to address the underrepresentation of women in the technology workforce by expanding access to education, skills development and career opportunities. The scholarship will initially be open to eligible students entering the second year of Bachelor of Technology (BTech) and Bachelor of Engineering (BE) programmes at participating institutions.

articles.title: From Rustication To Medals: Indian Athletes' Inspiring Asian Games Journeys
articles.summary: Soft tennis player Jay Meena on Friday recalled how school rustication led him to the sport and how he overcame repeated quarterfinal disappointments before scripting history with India's maiden Asian Games medal in the discipline. Meena described the quarterfinal stage as a "nightmare" during his 16-year sporting career, while reflecting on the setbacks and opportunities that shaped his journey.

articles.title: Himanta Biswa Sarma inaugurates New Assam House in Bengaluru, built at cost
articles.summary: Sharing the development, Sarma described the facility as a space built with care and purpose to support people from Assam travelling to Bengaluru for education, medical treatment and professional commitments. articles.title_hi: हिमंत बिस्वा सरमा ने बेंगलुरु में लागत से निर्मित न्यू असम हाउस का उद्घाटन किया

articles.summary_hi: यदि आप बाहर निकलना चाहते हैं, तो कृपया इस पृष्ठ के पाद लेख में "मेरी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी न बेचें या साझा न करें" लिंक पर क्लिक करें। हम आपके द्वारा देखे जाने वाले विज्ञापनों को सूचित करने के लिए आपकी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी को बेचेंगे या साझा नहीं करेंगे। यदि आपकी जानकारी अन्य कंपनियों द्वारा बेची या साझा की जाती है या पहले बेची या साझा की गई थी, तब भी आपको रुचि-आधारित विज्ञापन दिखाई दे सकते हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: Google ne AI shikshaka prashikshana ka vistara bihar, madhya pradesh, sikkima taka kiy; aba taka 80,000 shikshakon ko prashikshita kiya gaya
articles.summary_hinglish: yadi aapa bahara nikalana chahate hain, to kripaya isa prishtha ke pada lekha men "meri vyaktigata janakari na bechen ya sajha na karen" linka para klika karen। hama aapake dvara dekhe jane vale vijnyapanon ko suchita karane ke lie aapaki vyaktigata janakari ko bechenge ya sajha nahin karenge। yadi aapaki janakari anya kanpaniyon dvara bechi ya sajha ki jati hai ya pahale bechi ya sajha ki gaee thi, taba bhi aapako ruchi-aadharita vijnyapana dikhaee de sakate hain।

articles.title: Neemtree Entertainment brings ‘Sardar: The Architect of United India’ to Delhi
articles.summary: Sardar: The Architect of United India brings to the stage the extraordinary story of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel and his pivotal role in unifying India following Independence. After drawing audiences in Mumbai and travelling to Bhopal and across Gujarat, the theatrical production now arrives in Delhi, taking the story of one of India’s most consequential leaders to a wider audience.
articles.title_hi: नीमट्री एंटरटेनमेंट दिल्ली में 'सरदार: द आर्किटेक्ट ऑफ यूनाइटेड इंडिया' लेकर आया है
articles.summary_hi: सरदार: यूनाइटेड इंडिया के वास्तुकार सरदार वल्लभभाई पटेल की असाधारण कहानी और स्वतंत्रता के बाद भारत को एकजुट करने में उनकी महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका को मंच पर लाते हैं। मुंबई में दर्शकों को आकर्षित करने और भोपाल और पूरे गुजरात की यात्रा करने के बाद, नाट्य निर्माण अब दिल्ली में आता है, जो भारत के सबसे परिणामी नेताओं में से एक की कहानी को व्यापक दर्शकों तक ले जाता है।
articles.title_hinglish: nimatri entaratenamenta dilli men 'saradar: da aarkitekta ऑpha yunaiteda indiya' lekara aaya hai
articles.summary_hinglish: saradar: yunaiteda indiya ke vastukara saradara vallabhabhaee patela ki asadharana kahani aura svatantrata ke bada bharata ko ekajuta karane men unaki mahatvapurna bhumika ko mancha para late hain। munbaee men darshakon ko aakarshita karane aura bhopala aura pure gujarata ki yatra karane ke bad, natya nirmana aba dilli men aata hai, jo bharata ke sabase parinami netaon men se eka ki kahani ko vyapaka darshakon taka le jata hai।

articles.title: Reliance says Starlink welcome, but all players must follow Indian laws
articles.summary: Reliance Industries stated that it welcomes competition, including Starlink, in the satellite communications sector. The company emphasized the need for all players to comply with Indian laws and regulations. Reliance noted that its satellite services are also awaiting necessary approvals. Elon Musk raised concerns about competition being hindered by oligarchs in India.
articles.title_hi: रिलायंस का कहना है कि स्टारलिंक का स्वागत है, लेकिन सभी खिलाड़ियों को भारतीय कानूनों का पालन करना होगा
articles.summary_hi: रिलायंस इंडस्ट्रीज ने कहा कि वह उपग्रह संचार क्षेत्र में स्टारलिंक सहित प्रतिस्पर्धा का स्वागत करती है। कंपनी ने सभी खिलाड़ियों को भारतीय कानूनों और विनियमों का पालन करने की आवश्यकता पर जोर दिया। रिलायंस ने कहा कि उसकी उपग्रह सेवाएं भी आवश्यक मंजूरी का इंतजार कर रही हैं। एलोन मस्क ने भारत में कुलीन वर्गों द्वारा प्रतिस्पर्धा में बाधा डाले जाने पर चिंता जताई।
articles.title_hinglish: rilayansa ka kahana hai ki staralinka ka svagata hai, lekina sabhi khiladaिyon ko bharatiya kanunon ka palana karana hoga
articles.summary_hinglish: rilayansa indastrija ne kaha ki vaha upagraha sanchara kshetra men staralinka sahita pratispardha ka svagata karati hai। kanpani ne sabhi khiladaिyon ko bharatiya kanunon aura viniyamon ka palana karane ki aavashyakata para jora diya। rilayansa ne kaha ki usaki upagraha sevaen bhi aavashyaka manjuri ka intajara kara rahi hain। elona maska ne bharata men kulina vargon dvara pratispardha men badha dale jane para chinta jataee।

articles.title: Beyond mutual funds: The expanding opportunity for India's financial distributors
articles.summary: For India's financial distributors, mutual funds may be the starting point, but they are no longer the only avenue to explore. Portfolio management services (PMS), alternative investment funds (AIFs), insurance and fintech are creating a wider business landscape for professionals looking to expand their offerings and build stronger distribution businesses.
articles.title_hi: म्यूचुअल फंड से परे: भारत के वित्तीय वितरकों के लिए विस्तार का अवसर
articles.summary_hi: भारत के वित्तीय वितरकों के लिए, म्यूचुअल फंड शुरुआती बिंदु हो सकते हैं, लेकिन वे अब तलाशने का एकमात्र रास्ता नहीं हैं। पोर्टफोलियो प्रबंधन सेवाएं (पीएमएस), वैकल्पिक निवेश फंड (एआईएफ), बीमा और फिनटेक अपनी पेशकशों का विस्तार करने और मजबूत वितरण व्यवसाय बनाने के इच्छुक पेशेवरों के लिए एक व्यापक व्यावसायिक परिदृश्य तैयार कर रहे हैं।
articles.title_hinglish: myuchuala phanda se pare: bharata ke vittiya vitarakon ke lie vistara ka avasara
articles.summary_hinglish: bharata ke vittiya vitarakon ke lie, myuchuala phanda shuruaati bindu ho sakate hain, lekina ve aba talashane ka ekamatra rasta nahin hain। portapholiyo prabandhana sevaen (piemaesa), vaikalpika nivesha phanda (eaaeeepha), bima aura phinateka apani peshakashon ka vistara karane aura majabuta vitarana vyavasaya banane ke ichchhuka peshevaron ke lie eka vyapaka vyavasayika paridrishya taiyara kara rahe hain।

articles.title: Sale of books becomes latest political flashpoint in Bengal as Left stalls face attacks
articles.summary: The structure of a book stall being set up by the Communist Party of India (CPI) was also vandalised. The incidents come weeks after Adhikari, on September 10, urged Durga Puja committees to deny the CPI(M) space for book stalls if the party used the term “Sharodotsav”, or autumn festival, instead of Durga Puja.
